It has 4 low paying symbols represented by card suits and 4 high paying symbols represented by a Vault/Safe, Gold, Silver and Cash. There is a Wild symbol (Mamma Pig) that appears in the base game and in the Free Spins feature, which can expand and award a multiplier. There is a Scatter symbol (Blow it Down) that appears on reels 1, 3 and 5 in the base game and it triggers the Free Spins feature. It can also appear during the Free Spins feature, providing the opportunity to retrigger spins. Wolf Coin and Piggie Coin symbols can land on the reels in the base game and in the Free Spins feature, triggering the Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game which may award the Collect, Double or Mystery feature. Four Prizes can also be won during the Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game.</p> <h2>WILD SYMBOL</h2> <p>The Wild symbol (Mamma Pig) substitutes for all regular symbols.</p> <p>The Wild symbol is an Expanding Wild and appears in the base game and in the Free Spins feature.</p> <p>The Wild symbol can't expand over Scatter or Coin symbols.</p> <p>After all symbols land on their final positions, the Wild symbol may randomly expand and award a multiplier depending on its expansion stage:</p> <ul> <li>Single (no expansion) - 1x Multiplier.</li> <li>Double (2 row expansion) - 2x Multiplier.</li> <li>Full (3 row expansion, maximum size) - 3x Multiplier.</li> </ul> <p>When multiple multipliers appear on the reels, they are added together and applied to the total win. The maximum multiplier of the Wild symbols is 15x on the whole board filled with fully expanded 5 Wild symbols.</p> <h2>SCATTER SYMBOL</h2> <p>The Scatter symbol (Blow it Down) only lands on reels 1, 3 and 5.</p> <p>Landing 3 Scatter symbols in the base game triggers the Free Spins feature.</p> <img src=\"3_piggies_huff&puff\"/> <h2>COIN SYMBOLS</h2> <p>Wolf Coin and Piggie Coin symbols can land on the reels during the base game and the Free Spins feature.</p> <p>There are three types of Piggie Coin symbols, each linked to one of the three Banks:</p> <img src=\"3_piggies_coins_bonus_base\"/> <ul> <li>GREEN Piggie Coin - triggers the Collect feature.</li> </ul> <img src=\"3_piggies_coins_green\"/> <li>BLUE Piggie Coin - triggers the Double feature.</li> </ul> <img src=\"3_piggies_coins_blue\"/> <li>RED Piggie Coin - triggers the Mystery feature.</li> </ul> <img src=\"3_piggies_coins_red\"/> <p>Landing 6 or more Wolf Coin symbols together with 1 Piggie Coin symbol triggers the Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game. There is no possibility of landing 2 Piggie Coins at the same time with 6 or more Wolf Coin symbols. The type of Piggie Coin symbol determines which feature is played.</p> <h2>LOCK'EM & LOAD'EM BONUS GAME</h2> <p>The Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game is represented by 3 Piggie Banks displayed above the board. Every Piggie Coin that lands in the Base Game or in Free Spins is then transferred to the Piggie Bank of the same color.</p> <p>The Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game can be triggered in two ways: either by landing 6 or more Wolf Coin symbols with 1 Piggie Coin symbol, or by chance when collecting individual Piggie Coins during the base game or the Free Spins feature, regardless of the bet level.</p> <p>If the Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game is triggered during the Free Spin game, the Free Spin session must come to an end before the player is transported to the Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game.</p> <p>The Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game begins with an initial Free Spin that awards a starting set of 6+ Wolf Coins.</p> <p>Each Wolf Coin has a value between 1x and 10x the bet.</p> <p>After the initial Free Spin, the player is awarded 5 respins.</p> <p>Each time a new Coin symbol lands, the number of available respins resets to 5.</p> <p>Coin symbols that land remain locked in place for the remainder of the Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game.</p> <p>The Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game ends when the player runs out of respins or when all 15 positions on the reels are filled with Coin symbols.</p> <p>Only coins can appear during the Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game.</p> <p>The Piggie Bank's accumulated Coin Collection resets once the Lock'em & Load'em feature ends.</p> <p>Depending on the type of Bank that triggered the Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game, one of the following features is active:</p> <ul> <li>Collect Feature - Each Collect Piggie Coin receives a value that is a sum of all other coins on the board.</li> <li>Double Feature - Each Double Piggie Coin that lands multiplies the value of all Coin symbols on the board by x2. The Double Coin receives a random value between 1x and 150x the bet.</li> <li>Mystery Feature - Each Mystery Piggie Coin that lands receives a random value of 15x, 30x, 50x, 75x, 100x or 150x the bet.</li> </ul> <p>When the Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game ends, the values of all Coin symbols on the reels are added together and paid out as the Total Win.</p> <p>In the Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game there are 4 Prizes to be won.</p> <h2>PRIZES</h2> <p>Four Prizes can be won during the Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game: Mini, Minor, Major and Grand.</p> <ul> <li>Mini Prize - 15x bet.</li> </ul> <img src=\"3_piggies_coins_bonus_mini\"/> <ul> <li>Minor Prize - 50x bet.</li> </ul> <img src=\"3_piggies_coins_bonus_minor\"/> <ul> <li>Major Prize - 200x bet.</li> </ul> <img src=\"3_piggies_coins_bonus_major\"/> <ul> <li>Grand Prize - 1000x bet.</li> </ul> <p>To win a Mini, Minor or Major Prize, a special coin has to land on the board during the Lock'em & Load'em Bonus Game.</p> <p>Filling the 15 positions on the board with Coin symbols awards the Grand Prize of 1000x bet.</p> <h2>FREE SPINS</h2> <p>Landing 3 Scatter symbols on reels 1, 3 and 5 in the base game triggers 10 Free Spins.</p> <p>Free Spins are played on a 5-reel, 3-row grid with the same bet as the activating spin.</p> <p>If 3 Scatter symbols land during the Free Spins feature, the player is awarded an additional 10 Free Spins.</p> <p>The Wild symbol and Coin symbols can also appear during the Free Spins feature.</p> {{#ifEq isBuyBonusDisabled false}} <h2>BUY BONUS</h2> <p>Players can buy immediate access to a bonus feature.
